role: Gate: native structure starts (structure_walk, csrc/engine/structure.c) against StructuresProbe starts.jsonl files (out/java/structures/<dir>/): for each implemented type (Mineshaft, Stronghold, Temple, Village; Fortress in the Nether) recomputes the region's starts from the seed and compares their canonical NBT line by line.
notes: Test binary, not linked into the product; hazards listed are test-harness statics, not tick code. Types without a native implementation are reported and skipped. Member names in java[] are the vanilla hooks for start selection and NBT write; not re-verified in the Java files.
